metrics.source: NASA GIBS public MODIS/VIIRS true-color WMS
metrics.counting_note: remote_unique_windows_trained counts distinct requested geospatial/time WMS windows that were actually decoded and used for optimization. It is not a count of unique satellite source scenes. samples_seen includes local replay and must not be called an image count.

findings.title: Streaming target reached
findings.value: 200,016 distinct geospatial/time windows used for optimization
findings.detail: Target completion 100.008% from a candidate pool of 518,400 windows.

findings.title: Content diversity
findings.detail: 78.43% content-unique; 43,153 trained windows had payload content matching another trained window.

findings.title: Environmental conclusions
findings.value: Not established by this training run alone
findings.detail: The run decoded and optimized on imagery but did not persist water/snow/vegetation/shoreline pixel metrics. Environmental findings require a separate reproducible scene-analysis pass.
